dedupe_keys.name: usgs dataretrieval r and python clients

description: dataRetrieval, published by the U.S. Geological Survey, provides R and Python clients for loading hydrological observations and metadata from public services. Both implementations access USGS water data and the Water Quality Portal; the Python documentation also describes groundwater, network-linked and water-use services. Inputs specify locations, variables and periods; outputs include streamflow series, water-quality samples and monitoring-site metadata. Coverage is primarily United States monitoring networks, with daily, continuous or sample-based resolution depending on the service. Source is free under US public-domain terms and a worldwide CC0 dedication. A limitation is that NWIS functions are being replaced by newer Water Data APIs and water-quality formats are changing. API keys can raise service limits. The clients can prepare calibration observations for water-infrastructure simulations. USGS Water Data APIs (data-usgs-water-data-apis) are related upstream services. No observations, keys or software package were requested.
